lines.text: Every event in your stream is a decision. I B M Granite Time Series models score each one in flight, on Confluent. Poke it.
Switch to forecast: the next thirty-two steps, with the band.
Then optimize it. The optimizer finds the setting that earns the most and still meets spec. The operator approves.
Then an agent acts. Forecast, flag, reasoning, purchase order. Under a second, inside Confluent.
Three things change. Ten times faster to value, five to ten percent more accurate, and decisions in seconds, not days.
Every card has its own normal. The odd swipe is held before authorization.
I B M Network Intelligence. T S Pulse flags the anomaly, agents confirm the cause, and a ticket opens only when it is real.
Thirty models become two. Six months become eight to ten weeks. Accuracy from ninety-three to ninety-nine percent.
Bring us a stream and a decision. Contact us for opportunities.
